description: Descriptive statistics for a list of numbers: count, sum, mean, median, mode(s), min, max, range, sample and population variance and SD, standard error, coefficient of variation, quartiles (inclusive = Excel QUARTILE.INC, exclusive = QUARTILE.EXC, or Tukey median-of-halves), IQR, 1.5×IQR outlier fences and outliers, a frequency table (values, or Sturges bins when there are more than 20 distinct values) and z-scores. Paste numbers separated by spaces, commas, semicolons, | or new lines; headers and text are skipped and reported. Commas can be separators, thousands marks or decimal commas. Up to 1,000,000 numbers. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/stats-calc/

commas.description: In text: commas separate values (sep), are thousands marks (thou: 1,234), or decimal commas (dec: 1,5).

data.description: The numbers: a text blob (CSV column, list…) or an array of numbers.

zScores.description: Include a z-score for each value (first 1,000).

name: calc_stats
title: Descriptive statistics
